study_identification_part.si_4_title: Individual differences v. the average patient: mapping the heterogeneity in ADHD using normative models

dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.detail: Dutch cohort of the International Multicenter persistent ADHD CollaboraTion (IMpACT)
dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.supporting_text: "We selected adult participants with persistent ADHD and healthy individuals from the Dutch cohort of the International Multicenter persistent ADHD CollaboraTion (IMpACT...)"

dc_2_purpose_of_each_dataset.detail: Healthy individuals from IMpACT were used to estimate the normative model (using 10-fold cross-validation) and then the model trained on all healthy individuals was applied to participants with ADHD (also from IMpACT).
dc_2_purpose_of_each_dataset.supporting_text: "The normative range for this model in healthy individuals was estimated using 10-fold crossvalidation, then we applied the model trained on all healthy individuals to participants with ADHD."

model-1.model-name: gray and white matter volumetric model

dc_3_number_of_healthy_control_of_each_n.detail: 146 healthy individuals were used. For the application to ADHD, the model was trained on all 146. For the healthy group characterization, 10-fold CV was used.
dc_3_number_of_healthy_control_of_each_n.supporting_text: "Total (N) ... Healthy individuals ... 146" and "we applied the model trained on all healthy individuals to participants with ADHD."
